name: FirstPersonCamera
description: Walk-around, eye-height first-person camera driven by the keyboard (W/S walk, A/D turn, Q/E strafe). Walks into nothing: every step is swept against the scene's Obstacle footprints and slides along cabinet faces, with optional room `bounds` as the outer belt. Walks itself to a spot on a `firstpersoncamera.goto` (a clicked cabinet), and with a `persistKey` remembers where you stood between visits.
